title: LoongArch64 Runtime Parity
summary: v1.6 focuses on turning the LoongArch64 bring-up into a reliable user-space runtime.
scope: The release should close the current process, virtual-memory, and filesystem gaps while preserving the existing RISC-V test baseline.

items.title: Memory growth
items.description: implement and validate `brk` and the required address-space growth paths.

items.title: Copy-on-access memory
items.description: fix lazy page copying, page faults, and fork-related virtual-memory paths.

items.title: Memory mapping
items.description: bring `mmap`, lazy mapping, and mmap-after-fork to the LoongArch64 test baseline.

items.title: Fault and signal handling
items.description: report user faults correctly and terminate or signal processes without hangs.

items.title: Pipe and output paths
items.description: validate `sys_write` and pipe blocking, wakeup, close, and EOF behavior.

items.title: VirtIO block device
items.description: enable block I/O on the LoongArch64 QEMU target.

items.title: EasyFS root filesystem
items.description: boot LoongArch64 from an EasyFS image instead of an embedded or diskless init program.

items.title: Shell image
items.description: start `fvsh` and its standard user programs from the LoongArch64 root filesystem.

items.title: Architecture test matrix
items.description: run the RISC-V EasyFS/EXT4 and LoongArch64 tmpfs/EasyFS configurations in CI.

items.title: Failure diagnostics
items.description: make QEMU timeouts and kernel faults identify the failing test and path.

items.title: Rust boundary validation
items.description: keep the Rust console and allocator integration build- and panic-safe without making Rust feature expansion a release blocker.
